subject: Dedicated capacity economics & GPU tradeoffs — post-call recap
message_1_subject: Dedicated capacity economics & GPU tradeoffs — post-call recap
message_1_body:
Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call today — great to meet the Atlas team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Workload profile (what we heard):
- Inference pattern: mix of short chat-like turns (avg 60 tokens/request) and longer batch re-ranks (avg 1,200 tokens).
- Peak concurrency target: ~120 concurrent sessions during promos.
- Sustained 24h baseline: ~20 qps (mixed lengths) with spikes to ~80 qps for 20-30 minute windows.

2) Pricing / economics items we need from Atlas to finalize sizing: 
- Target unit economics: you mentioned a target of roughly $10–$12 per 1M tokens for production inference (is that correct?), and an internal cap of $150k/year for the inference line item.
- Expected monthly token volume: you gave a range 150M–400M tokens/mo depending on feature rollout. Please confirm a monthly midpoint you’d like us to price to.

3) Redwood recommendation (initial):
- GPU family: H100 80GB for best latency at your long-sequence / re-rank use cases; A10G-based lanes for cost-effective shorter chat traffic. We typically recommend a 2-pool approach: 4x H100 for the re-rank/heavy workloads + 8x A10G for chat at your scale.
- Reserved capacity sizing: starting committed pool of 12 GPUs (4 H100 + 8 A10G) with burst headroom on our Dedicated fabric. This maps to estimated steady throughput ~350M tokens/mo at your reported mix and ~95% latency SLO compliance.
- Cost guidance (ballpark): $9–$11 / 1M tokens when committed and with cache/batching enabled (this factors in reserved GPU amortization + expected utilization).

4) Immediate next steps:
- Please confirm the single-month midpoint token volume you want us to quote to (suggest 250M).
- If procurement prefers a single GPU family for procurement simplicity, flag that and we’ll re-run the econ to show single-family tradeoffs (cost vs latency).
- We’ll produce a draft reserved-capacity quote + SOW once you confirm the midpoint and whether you prefer mixed pools.

I’ve attached a draft scope + a preliminary quote template — Ben will follow with a formal PDF quote after we get your midpoint.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

- Procurement note: procurement prefers a single SKU family initially for easier contracting, but engineering strongly prefers H100 for re-ranks. Can we show both single-family (H100 only) and mixed-pool econ?

We can aim to get procurement input this week. Please send both variants so we can compare.

Best,
Elena

message_3_subject: Re: Dedicated capacity economics & GPU tradeoffs — variants attached
message_3_body:
Elena — attaching two quick econ sketches inline below and sending formal worksheets shortly. High level: two scenarios priced to 275M tokens/mo (midpoint you gave) and to 375M tokens/mo (procurement stress test).

Scenario A — Mixed pool (recommended):
- Pool: 4x H100 + 8x A10G (reserved)
- Expected effective throughput: ~300–320M tokens/mo at 85–90% utilization; burst can hit ~420M/mo equivalent for short windows.
- Estimated blended unit cost: $8.5 / 1M tokens (with caching and batching assumptions: 15% prefix cache hit, 20% batching uplift).

Scenario B — H100-only (procurement-preferred single SKU):
- Pool: 10x H100 reserved
- Expected effective throughput: ~380–410M tokens/mo at 85–90% utilization (you get more headroom on long sequences).
- Estimated blended unit cost: $11 / 1M tokens (higher $/1M due to H100 amortization but lower latency for re-ranks).

Latency delta: for chat (avg 60 tokens) we expect median token latency to be ~12–18ms/token on A10G vs ~6–9ms/token on H100 for the same model and sequence, so end-to-end response time for chat will be ~150–400ms (A10G) vs ~80–200ms (H100) depending on model. For re-ranks (1,200 tokens) H100 yields much tighter tail latency.

Ask: confirm which scenario you want the formal SOW/quote for first (Mixed pool priced to 275M or H100-only priced to 375M). Once you confirm we’ll circulate the formal quote + SOW and a short runbook for rolling this into Dedicated.

Thanks,
Vanessa

> Attachment notes: worksheets will show amortization, reserved discount, and an optional burst allowance.
